limitations.note: The two-state toggle keeps the converter from emitting the second 12-bit word on the third valid byte, which requires a reachable count-2 state and matching data-output branch.
The rewrite changes the already-correct first output word by taking the second byte’s low nibble instead of its high nibble.
The test explicitly expects no output on the third valid byte, so it passes the faulty rewrite instead of checking for the required second output word.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted.
